import numpy as np
def build(protrusions):
    g=np.zeros((15,15),int)
    g[2,3:12]=3; g[10,3:12]=3; g[2:11,3]=3; g[2:11,11]=3
    for p in protrusions: g[p]=3
    return g
def solve(g):
    ps=[(r,c) for r in range(15) for c in range(15) if g[r,c]==3 and 3<=r<=9 and 4<=c<=10]
    seed = ps[0] if ps else (6,7)
    out=g.copy()
    for r in range(3,10):
        for c in range(4,11):
            if g[r,c]!=0: continue
            d=max(abs(r-seed[0]),abs(c-seed[1]))
            out[r,c]= 3 if d==0 else (4 if d%2==1 else 2)
    return out
